platzhalter: Ask your library … e.g. When does the car insurance expire?
leer: Ask a question in full sentences. The sources from your library appear under each answer.
keine-quellen: The answer doesn’t name a source from your library.
geschickt_one: Sent to the AI: {anzahl} excerpt from {mappen} folder
geschickt_other: Sent to the AI: {anzahl} excerpts from {mappen} folders
geschickt.keine: Sent to the AI: only the question – nothing in your library matches it.
geschickt.gekuerzt_one: Sent to the AI: {geschickt} of {anzahl} excerpt (shortened)
geschickt.gekuerzt_other: Sent to the AI: {geschickt} of {anzahl} excerpts (shortened)
verlauf.gekuerzt_one: The package left out the oldest entry of this chat – too long for the AI service.
verlauf.gekuerzt_other: The package left out the {anzahl} oldest entries of this chat – too long for the AI service.
hinweis: The answer is written by the AI service of the package “{paket}” – only from the passages you see below each answer. Check anything important in the sources.
verlauf: The chat stays only in this browser window and is gone when you reload.
werkbank.text: This package answers questions about the library. For each question Ablago itself looks for matching passages – only in folders the person asking may read – and passes at most this much of them to the package.
werkbank.zeichen: At most characters per question (all excerpts together)
adresse.text: The package sends data to {adresse} – for “Ask your library”, for example, the question and a few excerpts from documents. Operation and hosting of this service are outside Ablago. If it runs in your own network, the data doesn’t leave the house. If it belongs to another provider, you are trusting that provider – just as when hosting Ablago itself: with this choice you decide on location, data processing agreement, storage and use for training.
adresse.feld: The package may access the network only at this address. By saving, you confirm it.
adresse.installation: This package sends data to a service address you enter in the settings after installation. Operation and hosting of this service are outside Ablago: in your own network the data doesn’t leave the house; with another provider, you are trusting that provider.
